2026_01_DAL_NYG.headline: Dallas’ interior protection meets New York’s pass-rush identity under the lights
2026_01_DAL_NYG.paragraph1: Dallas enters the opener without Pro Bowl guard Tyler Smith, putting T.J. Bass into the lineup against a Giants defense built around front-seven pressure. New York has its own major uncertainty with Malik Nabers listed questionable after working back from last season’s knee injury. That creates two different leverage points: the Giants need their rush to disrupt Dak Prescott before Dallas’ receivers separate, while Dallas must keep Jaxson Dart from finding rhythm. Protection, explosive passes and the availability of Nabers will heavily influence the game’s shape.
2026_01_DAL_NYG.model_rationale: Dallas can control the matchup if its replacement protection holds up, while New York’s clearest route is front-four disruption and enough explosive offense to keep Prescott from dictating tempo.
